name: ASH Annual Meeting and Exposition 2026
description: The ASH Annual Meeting and Exposition is the primary scientific meeting of the American Society of Hematology, covering malignant and non-malignant blood disorders. The 68th edition is scheduled for December 12 to 15, 2026 at the Ernest N. Morial Convention Center in New Orleans, Louisiana, with in person and virtual attendance options.

deadlines.note: 9:00 AM Eastern time; posts presentation format (plenary, oral, or poster). A separate, imprecisely dated acceptance notification is described elsewhere as early October 2026 and is not included as a discrete entry.

deadlines.note: 11:00 AM Eastern time; non-members, groups, exhibitors, media.

name: ASH Annual Meeting and Exposition 2027
description: The ASH Annual Meeting and Exposition is the primary scientific meeting of the American Society of Hematology, covering malignant and non-malignant blood disorders. As of September 2026, the American Society of Hematology had not yet published dates or a location for the 69th edition in 2027.

notes: No official date or location for the 69th ASH Annual Meeting (2027) has been published by hematology.org as of 2026-09-10. Aggregator sites (showsbee.com, life-sciences-usa.com) list placeholder values such as a generic December 2027 or a 2027-12-01 start date, but these are not sourced from ASH and were deliberately not used to populate start_date or end_date, per instructions never to invent a date. No deadlines are estimated because doing so would require first guessing the meeting date itself, which is not yet public; the prior (2026) edition's dates are recorded above for reference only.
